import numpy as np
G=np.ones((30,30),dtype=int)
# vertical top lines
G[0:5,10]=7; G[0:5,23]=7; G[4,10:24]=7
# vertical divider
G[4:30,18]=7
# frame middle
G[15,6:13]=7; G[15:23,6]=7; G[15:23,12]=7; G[22,6:13]=7; G[19,0:7]=7
# bottom U
G[23:30,9]=7; G[15:30,18]=7; G[29,9:19]=7
# seeds
for r,c,v in [(2,21,9),(20,10,2),(21,11,9),(27,15,4),(28,16,9),(29,17,5),(28,28,8),(29,29,2),(29,8,8)]: G[r,c]=v
# inspect connected components of non-wall cells
from collections import deque
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(30):
 for c in range(30):
  if G[r,c]==7 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
  while q:
   x,y=q.popleft(); comp.append((x,y))
   for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
    a,b=x+dx,y+dy
    if 0<=a<30 and 0<=b<30 and G[a,b]!=7 and (a,b) not in seen:
     seen.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))
  comps.append(comp)
print(len(comps), sorted([(len(x), (min(r for r,c in x),max(r for r,c in x),min(c for r,c in x),max(c for r,c in x)),[(r,c,G[r,c]) for r,c in x if G[r,c]!=1]) for x in comps],key=lambda t:t[1]))
